Q9029.reason: Hypotonic water absorbed across the bladder mucosa can cause fluid and electrolyte imbalance, so saline is used for washout.

Q9030.reason: Under the modern vesting rule the parties may modify a third-party beneficiary contract before the beneficiary assents, sues, or relies, and the son learned of it only after payment.

Q9031.reason: A general ban on assigning the contract does not bar assignment of the right to payment unless that right is specifically restricted, and even a specific bar usually does not invalidate the assignment.
